biography: Wheatstone was an English physicist and inventor at King's College London. Beginning with acoustics and musical instruments, he turned to vision, electrical measurement and telegraphy. His collaboration with Cooke connected precision experiments with practical communications.

Popularized and improved bridge methods for measuring electrical resistance
Developed practical telegraph systems with Cooke and investigated sound and electrical-signal propagation

biography: Rudolf Kohlrausch was a German physicist who taught in schools and universities and specialized in electrical measurement. Advanced electrostatic measurement and electrical metrology

biography: Foote was an American experimental researcher, inventor and women's-rights advocate with training in science. Her home experiments compared the solar heating of gases. Proposed an early connection between atmospheric carbon dioxide abundance and Earth's temperature
